source_behavior.summary: Administrator-only AI Prompt Templates registry page that reads the real prompt store, current template state and append-only revision history.
source_behavior.operation_boundary: This route operation owns only opening/rendering the prompt registry. New, Save and Restore are distinct canonical controls and are not claimed by this wave.
source_behavior.read_semantics: read-only registry inspection; the canonical route itself performs no prompt mutation

laravel_adaptation.runtime_data: real persisted tenant-scoped prompt templates and append-only revisions; no demo/sample rows
laravel_adaptation.read_side_effect_rule: The controller queries the persisted models directly and deliberately does not call PromptRegistryService::all(), because that service may lazily seed built-ins and would violate canonical mutation=false semantics on GET.

runtime_path: auth + tenant.context resolve an active membership for the route tenant
AiPromptTemplatesReadController authorizes settings.manage and rechecks the active TenantContext slug against the route tenant
AiPromptTemplate and AiPromptRevision are read through the existing BelongsToTenant global scope
the server-rendered view presents the authoritative template content, status/current revision and persisted revision history
an empty tenant registry renders an explicit zero-template empty state without seeding or inventing records

authorization.source_equivalence: settings.manage is the existing Laravel administrator/settings-management permission used for tenant settings administration

tenant_and_idor_isolation.tenant_scope: AiPromptTemplate and AiPromptRevision both use the shared BelongsToTenant scope under the active TenantContext
tenant_and_idor_isolation.tenant_a_to_tenant_b_route: 404 when the authenticated user lacks an active membership for the requested tenant
tenant_and_idor_isolation.direct_id_surface: none; the canonical route accepts only the tenant slug and introduces no template/revision identifier parameter
tenant_and_idor_isolation.foreign_template_proof: focused acceptance persists a Beta template with secret content and proves it is absent from the Alpha response

runtime_semantics.fake_success_path: not applicable; this operation is read-only
runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: each GET reads the current persisted tenant-scoped template and revision rows
runtime_semantics.idempotency: GET-only; focused acceptance proves prompt/revision record counts are unchanged by the read
runtime_semantics.retry_safety: repeated requests repeat only the same authorized tenant-scoped read
runtime_semantics.truthful_empty_state: zero persisted templates renders an explicit empty state and leaves both prompt tables empty
runtime_semantics.audit_or_mutation_receipt: not applicable because this canonical operation is read-only
